shortDescription: Rajasthan University of Health Sciences has invited online applications for 600 Medical Officer posts. Apply online from 14 September 2026 to 13 October 2026.
content:
Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS), Jaipur has released the notification for RUHS Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 for 600 posts.

Eligible candidates can apply online from 14/09/2026 to 13/10/2026. The tentative examination date is 13/12/2026. Candidates should read the official notification for complete eligibility, syllabus, department-wise details, selection procedure and pay scale.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 14/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 13/10/2026
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 13/10/2026
  • RUHS Medical Officer Exam Date: 13/12/2026 (Tentative)
  • Admit Card: 08/12/2026 (Tentative)

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹5000
  • Rajasthan State SC / ST: ₹2500

Pay the examination fee through the prescribed online or offline fee mode.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 22 years
  • Maximum Age: 45 years as on 01/01/2027

Age relaxation is applicable as per RUHS Medical Officer recruitment rules.

Vacancy Details

  • Post: Medical Officer
  • Total Posts: 600
  • Category distribution: UR 216, BC 126, EWS 60, SC 96, ST 72, MBC 30

Check the official notification for complete eligibility, syllabus and recruitment instructions before applying.
